messages:
rachel: Quick sync: product wants to run a controlled v1->v2 migration batch next week for ~50 mid-market tenants. Goals: minimize surprised customers, avoid quota/dedicated pool thrashing, and ship safe console affordances for opt-in/rollbacks. Thoughts?

ev an: spelling: evan :) But +1. Need to confirm routing policy semantics: are we doing full-cutover routing or gradual split with prefix caching preserved?

rachel: Plan from PM: offer two flows per tenant (1) opt-in soft-route: 10% traffic to v2 with shadow compare and one-click scale (2) opt-in full-route: all traffic to v2 with automatic fallback to v1 for 5m on errors. Console button should show estimated token cost delta and latency delta.

mira: For safety we should enforce per-tenant rate caps on opt-in full-route for first 24h: cap at baseline*1.2 QPS. Also require that tenant's compatibility score (internal) >= 70 for full-route. If below 70, only allow soft-route.

sasha: Telemetry needs: pre/post histograms of response shape (json schema diffs), token distribution, latency p95, and a small sample of actual response pairs for manual QA. Add metric tags `migration.batch_id` and `migration.mode`.

finance-bot: finance-bot: remind: any migration that increases billed tokens must be obvious. Add UI checkbox: "I acknowledge token/billing changes may apply" for full-route.

rachel: Good call. Also product asks for a "migration concierge" option where Solutions Eng can request a 14-day grace (billing credit & extended support). That requires a grace allowlist and admin approval flow.

ev an: Router implications: we need to implement a rollout primitive: route.rule = {percent: X, fallback: v1|v2, fallback_window_seconds: 300, annotate: [migration.batch_id]}. Also need to ensure KV cache keys include model+version tag so v1 and v2 prefixes don't collide.

mira: On quotas: Dedicated pools count: when we split traffic, traffic still hits same pool if model variant is same hardware requirement. But if v2 pin uses a newer model variant with different GPU profile, it could spill to general pool. We must surface estimated pool impact in console before full-route.

sasha: UX sketch: console modal shows three tabs: "Preview diffs" (shows sample pairs), "Cost impact" (projected monthly delta), "Ops settings" (throttle cap, fallback window, allowlist). Button: "Start soft-route (10%)" or "Start full-route" (if threshold met).

rachel: Implementation owners: evan -> router rollout primitive + audit tagging (ETA 2 days), mira -> quota/pool impact estimator + enforcement (ETA 3 days), sasha -> console modal + mockups (ETA 2 days), finance -> configure migration-concierge policy (TBD).

router-bot: router-bot: preflight check: migration primitive schema validated. Suggested default fallback_window_seconds=300, safety_percent_step=10, safety_cooldown_minutes=30.

mira: Also propose automatic telemetry-based rollback: if output-match < 94% OR regression alert rate > 1% over 30m, then auto-failover to v1 for that tenant and notify owners. Need to define "output-match" metric (embedding similarity > 0.92).

ev an: Agree. Implement the auto-failover as an immutable rule in router: if metric triggers -> set percent=0 for v2 for tenant, create incident entry with migration.batch_id. We'll need to surface reason in console.

sasha: On the copy for console, keep language calm: "Experimental migration: your integration will be partially routed to v2 for testing. You can pause or revert anytime. If we detect large divergences we'll automatically revert and notify you."

finance-bot: finance-bot: for migration-concierge credits, finance needs a lookup: tenant plan, avg tokens/month, credit cap tier. Please open a ticket with SRE/Product when requesting a concierge add.

rachel: One open question: billing for shadow compare traffic during soft-route. Should shadow compare requests be non-billable? Product prefers non-billable for the v2 shadow portion for transparency. Operations: is that easy?

mira: It's doable if router tags shadow_requests and accounting ignores tag `migration.shadow_free`. But that requires accounting to respect that tag; need finance sign-off. Might be easier to bill normally and issue a manual credit for the batch.

evan: Technical note: don't double-count tokens if we both route (10%) and shadow (100%) for the same request. If soft-route means route 10% and simultaneously shadow 90% we must ensure shadows are non-billable. Otherwise token spikes.

sasha: UX alternative: soft-route = split traffic (no full shadow). i.e., 10% go to v2, 90% stay v1, and we sample additional request pairs separately via "probe" mode where customer can run specific prompts through the diff tool. Less billing complexity.

rachel: Product likes that. Let's make soft-route split-only by default and provide an explicit "run probe" button in console to send a batch of example prompts through both models (probe can be non-billable or billed with consent).

router-bot: router-bot: note: will add boolean flag `probe_mode` separate from `percent_rollout`. probe_mode triggers parallel execution and must be annotated for billing as `probe=true`.

mira: Final list of action items: evan -> rollout primitive + auto-failover hooks (2d), mira -> pool impact estimator + accounting tag proposal doc (2d), sasha -> console modal + probe UX (2d), product -> concierge policy doc and tenant list (rachel), finance -> confirm billing treatment for probes and shadows (ETA 2d).

rachel: OK team. We'll start a migration batch next Tue morning. If any blockers surface, call it out here. Closing loop but will post batch_id once scheduled. :rocket:
